Woodworth Outdoors

Communications & Marketing · Family Business
Social Media Strategy Brand Identity Content Creation Web Development Client Relations Marketing

Woodworth Outdoors is my family's lawn & landscape business. Founded more than 25 years ago by my father, Kevin D. Woodworth, Woodworth Outdoors has become a staple in my life and a defining influence on how I perceive business, communications, and client relations. Joining my family's team when I was just 15 years old, I quickly learned the value of hard work, integrity, and the benefit of maintaining strong client relationships.

As I evolved into the communications & business professional I am today, I began implementing my skills and experience in communications & media relations into my family's business — with the goal of taking its exposure to the next level.

What started as learning the trade in the field has grown into a full creative and communications role. I now manage Woodworth Outdoors' social media presence, develop marketing content, and built the business's website from the ground up — bringing the same strategic approach to my family's brand that I apply to my professional work in the industry.

Fall Cleanup · Facebook & Instagram · November 25, 2025

🍂🧹 Fall cleanups are in full swing

A full backyard transformation — this property had thick layers of leaves built up across the entire yard. We cleared everything out and brought it to the curb for a fresh reset before winter.

Did you know? Leaf buildup left on your lawn under snow and moisture can cause permanent damage, including dead patches, mold, and disease in the spring. Keeping your lawn clear now protects it later.
